cards.subject: The breadbasket of Stormwind
lines: This was worked farmland, inside living memory, and it fed the capital.
It did not simply fail. The soil was salted on purpose so that nothing would grow, and the fields have gone to weeds and seedling trees.

cards.subject: Old Blanchy
lines: The old white mare is standing at the Jansen Stead with the Furlbrows, and the whole quest is to bring her oats.
The reward is her own blanket and her feed pouch.
Jeff Kaplan called her his favourite character in the game. Her death is Cataclysm and has not happened.

cards.subject: The Furlbrows
lines: Theodore and Verna are not on their farm. They are by the roadside near the Elwynn border with the horse and the cart.
Furlbrow's Pumpkin Farm is off to the northwest, still wearing their name.
They are not in it.

cards.subject: The harvest golems
lines: Where they came from is genuinely uncertain — goblin-built and Defias-commissioned are both told about them.
The story that sticks: the earliest models killed so completely that no witness ever escaped to spread word, so the tinkers built a flaw back in, so one person would always get away and talk.
Now they are the reason nobody walks the fields.

cards.subject: Sentinel Hill
lines: The walls, the siege engines and the garrison people picture are Cataclysm.
Here it is a watchtower with a militia camped around it, a forge and a gryphon.
The inn was only added in patch 0.9, during development. The tower came first.

cards.subject: Captain Stoutmantle
lines: Not Marshal, and there is no Westfall Brigade. Both are later titles.
The militia is a volunteer force he founded himself, because Stormwind sent nothing.
A Knight of the Silver Hand who left the war to come home and found this.

cards.subject: The Defias Brotherhood
lines: The bandits in the fields are the Stonemasons Guild — the men who rebuilt the capital after the Second War and were never paid.
The House of Nobles, with Lady Katrana Prestor in the room, disbanded the guild rather than settle. The riot killed Queen Tiffin: a thrown stone to the head.
Edwin VanCleef took what was left of them west.

cards.subject: Alexston Farmstead
lines: The Defias hold a burnt farm in the middle of the zone, and it carries the name of Baros Alexston — the man who is architect of Stormwind City.
Nothing in the zone stops to tell you that.
The capital's draughtsman and a dead farm share a name and you have to notice it yourself.

cards.subject: Moonbrook
lines: It had a tavern, a blacksmith, stables, a barn and a schoolhouse.
It is the only place in Westfall shaped like a town, and it has no vendor and no innkeeper.
Everything is still standing. There is simply nobody in it.

cards.subject: Where the Deadmines are
lines: The entrance is not signposted and it is not a door in a hillside. It is a hole in a floor, inside the town.
A whole dungeon is under the schoolhouse district and the zone never says so.
Stand at the top. The mine's own telling takes it from there.

cards.subject: Old Murk-Eye
lines: The rare elite murloc patrolling the Longshore is not scenery.
He led the raid that killed the lighthouse keeper's family. Twice — the second time fatally, while the keeper watched.
Killing him is the keeper's own request.

cards.subject: Captain Grayson
lines: The oil you bring him is drained out of the harvest golems in the fields, five flasks at a time.
He tells you what he is himself: "I died needlessly on this very shore. My afterlife plight is to see that no others follow my destiny."
His ship struck the rocks because the light was black that night. Now he tends it.
